rule.title: Prohibited Actions Regarding Criminal History
rule.requirement: [Basis: official explanatory text, not operative legal text] With regard to current or prospective tenants, it is unlawful to inquire about criminal history, indicate that persons with criminal backgrounds will not be considered for housing, refuse to rent or terminate a tenancy based on criminal history, require disclosure or authorization for release of criminal history, demand a higher security deposit or rental amount based on criminal history, refuse to allow the addition of an immediate family member based on criminal history, disqualify tenants from rental assistance programs based on criminal history, or treat applicants or tenants differently based on criminal history.
rule.exemptions: Lifetime sex offenders are exempt as specified in the Ordinance. [BMC 13.106]; Public housing and Section 8 properties have limited exemptions as specified in the Ordinance. [BMC 13.106]; Units under a rental agreement allowing owners to move back into their home pursuant to BMC 13.76.130 A.9 are exempt. [BMC 13.106]; Units occupied by existing tenants seeking to sublet or add or replace roommates are exempt. [BMC 13.106]
